name: The dog stops dead
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) a warning at SARO. A dog down the road, then nothing (a sign: the night goes quiet).

beats.text: The dog quit all at once. Like somebody told it to.
At {clock} a dog down the road went wild for a few seconds and then stopped dead, and every cricket around the station stopped with it.
